data.name: Mahmoud
data.gender_notes: Mahmoud is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d), 'to praise'. Maḥmūd means 'praised'. Its root is ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d). A common Arabic given name. Mahmoud is a Arabic name meaning “Praised; commendable”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mahmoud expresses “Praised; commendable”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-م-د (ḥ-m-d), 'to praise'. Maḥmūd means 'praised'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mahmoud total 30, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
